verdict.rationale: Docs confirm Atlas lets founders create, send, and track SAFEs from the Dashboard, and provides Cooley-developed legal document templates plus equity issuance/83(b) filing, indicating standard-terms documents are generated rather than drafted from scratch. However, evidence doesn't detail convertible notes specifically, nor confirm e-signature workflows or full customization scope, and community feedback notes gaps requiring outside lawyers for other paperwork. Missing for 10: explicit convertible note support, signing/e-signature flow details, independent hands-on confirmation of SAFE generation quality.
